provenance.audit: the AST enums of oak-dot, oak-mermaid and oak-plantuml were compared field by field with the lowering branches of plotter.input.*

supported.construct: a single non-strict graph
graph id
supported.note: the id names the graph and carries no scene geometry, so it is dropped as a documented no-op

supported.construct: rankdir TB / BT / LR / RL
node statement with label / shape / style
edge statement and chained operands
node [...] and edge [...] defaults, scoped to the subgraph they appear in
subgraph cluster_* with a label attribute
subgraph rank=same
compass ports n / e / s / w
shapes box / rect / rectangle / square / plaintext / diamond / circle
style=rounded on a node

approximated.loss: the fill comes from the theme and the line weight is not applied

approximated.construct: compass ports ne / nw / se / sw / c
approximated.loss: folded to the nearest axis anchor
a graph label has no scene carrier

refused.gap: downstream has no nested cluster frame

refused.construct: subgraph that is neither cluster_* nor rank=same
directed operator in an undirected graph and the reverse
graph assignment other than rankdir / label
element attribute outside label / shape / style
graph with no nodes and no edges

supported.construct: flowchart / graph with TD / TB / BT / LR / RL
node shapes Box / Round / Stadium / Subroutine / Cylinder / Circle / Rhombus
edge statements with solid / dotted / thick / invisible styles
subgraph with a title
supported.sample:
flowchart LR
  subgraph group[Group]
    A --> B
  end

supported.construct: classDiagram class bodies with fields and methods
classDiagram relations inheritance / composition / aggregation / association / dependency
sequenceDiagram participant / actor declarations
sequenceDiagram messages with solid / dotted / solid-arrow / dotted-arrow
supported.sample:
sequenceDiagram
  participant A
  participant B
  A->>B: hello
  B-->>A: world

supported.construct: stateDiagram / stateDiagram-v2 states, composite states, transitions, and [*] pseudo states
supported.sample:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Idle
  Idle --> Busy: start
  Busy --> [*]

supported.construct: erDiagram entities, attributes with PK / FK keys, and crow's foot cardinality on both ends

approximated.loss: inner clusters flatten into the outer frame
each region becomes one flat frame and nested states join every ancestor frame

refused.construct: gantt / pie / journey / gitGraph / mindmap / timeline / requirementDiagram / quadrantChart / xychart-beta / sankey-beta / block-beta / C4Context / zenuml
orientation outside TD / TB / BT / LR / RL
parallelogram / trapezoid / hexagon / double circle / asymmetric node shape
flowchart discarded statements style / classDef / class / linkStyle / click / direction / accTitle / accDescr
class discarded statements direction / note / style / cssClass / linkStyle / namespace / click / acctitle / accTitle / accDescr / callback / link

sequence discarded statements title / accTitle / accDescr / note / loop / alt / else / opt / par / critical / break / rect / end / activate / deactivate / autonumber / box / create / destroy / link / linkStyle
state discarded statements direction / note / style / classDef / class / click / linkStyle / title / acctitle / accTitle / accDescr
entity relationship discarded statements title / acctitle / accTitle / accDescr / direction / style / classDef / click / linkStyle / note
flowchart with no nodes and no edges

supported.construct: @startuml / @enduml pair with content between them
class / interface / abstract / enum with visibility members
class relations association / inheritance / composition / aggregation / dependency / link
sequence participant / actor with solid / dotted / solid-arrow / dotted-arrow messages and activate / deactivate
line comments and /' ... '/ block comments

refused.construct: activity / state / component / deployment / usecase / object / timing / gantt / mindmap / wbs / salt / ditaa / nwdiag / rackdiag / packetdiag / archimate / gitgraph / chart
refused.gap: oak-plantuml only builds class and sequence diagrams

refused.construct: skinparam / note / alt / else / loop / group / par / opt / break / critical / ref / box / title / caption / header / footer / legend / scale / autonumber / newpage / hide / show / left / right / top / bottom / allow_mixing
class and sequence mixed in one source

supported.construct: tikzpicture environment or its bare body
\draw / \fill / \filldraw with -- polylines
rectangle and circle primitives
node[options]{text} inside a path
standalone `\node[options] at (x,y) {text}`
options dashed / thin / thick / very thick / line width / opacity / fill opacity / fill / color / draw / text
xcolor base colour names black / white / red / green / blue / cyan / magenta / yellow / gray / darkgray / lightgray / brown / lime / olive / orange / pink / purple / teal / violet
scale and node placement above / below / left / right
units cm / mm / pt

approximated.loss: the dash pattern is sampled into segments

refused.construct: \clip and every command outside the subset
